sources.usage: Project brief, enums, allowed design space, ranges, and schemas.
Public/cleared/provisional source usability registry; distinguishes formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and needs-review materials.
Agent-readable navigation layer for scopes, required tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing-data checklist; not a new authority source.
Submitted site boundary geometry source (provisional).
Three required detailed-design key area boundaries (provisional).
Official announcement tasks, scope levels, key areas, language, and deliverable context.
Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, scenario/branding/operation requirements, and boundary clause.
City-level policy and method reference for walking/cycling priority, network continuity, intersection improvement and links between streets, greenways and waterfront routes; not a local baseline.

Local public-participation evidence that North Third Ring Road, Sidaokou Road, Jingbao Road and Zhichun Road junction types require careful factual and engineering review; not an adopted project control for this submission.
Public-service context for 24-hour opening, stated accessibility condition and absence of on-site public parking; catalogue text requires field verification.
Resident-oriented service principle: everyday basic and quality services should be accessible within roughly a 15-minute walk; used as a design objective, not proof of current coverage.

Future-development background for the approximately 9 km innovation link, three-area/two-wing network and integration of spatial, transport and development planning; reported figures are not official polygons or statutory controls.

sources.query_extent: provisional site boundary plus 800 m analytical buffer
sources.usage: Background-only transport accessibility screening for mapped station names, crossings and walking/cycling line density. Not used for official boundaries, road redlines, engineering feasibility or precise capacity conclusions.

Beijing climate-adaptation action plan: heat, extreme precipitation, urban flooding, public health, water security, early warning and climate-resilient urban systems. Used as risk and governance evidence, not as site-specific downscaled climate data.

Beijing urban waterlogging and overflow-pollution implementation plan: source reduction, pipe conveyance, storage, exceedance emergency routes, maintenance, responsibility and a central-urban-road benchmark of 54 mm/h without ponding. Used as a benchmark and design dependency, not as proof of local performance.

Beijing water-work report: forecast, pre-release, flood storage, drainage maintenance, mixed-connection correction and water-network resilience. Used to require operations and pre-storm inspection, not to claim local pipe capacity.

Beijing DB11/1761-2020 walking and cycling environment planning/design standard and implementation notice. Used for continuity, public-space, street-form and maintenance-review requirements; project-specific dimensions remain for professional confirmation.

Beijing accessibility regulation: universal design, consultation with disability and ageing organizations, connected routes, information access and responsibility for repair. Used to make accessibility a hard gate rather than a visual add-on.

2026 Beijing municipal-road/bridge maintenance scope: inspection, facilities inventory, flood-season response, bridge/tunnel/equipment repair and emergency operations. Used to structure asset ownership and maintenance tests, not as a project budget.

ISO 55001:2024 asset-management system requirements: lifecycle performance, risk, expenditure, operations, maintenance and continual improvement. Used as a lifecycle-management framework, not as a substitute for local procurement or asset-owner requirements.

ISO 13482 personal-care robot safety scope and hazard-reduction principles for mobile servant, physical assistant and person-carrier robots. Used for embodied-AI test boundaries; not a public-space deployment approval.

ISO/TR 4448-1:2024 public-area mobile-robot paradigm covering shared kerbsides/pathways, automated and non-automated devices, bystanders and remote operation. Used to plan human-first shared space and test governance.
NIST human-centered AI programme. Used to keep AI services explainable, participatory and accountable to human perception and experience.
WHO urban-health evidence on air pollution, noise, heat islands, green/blue spaces, mobility, safety and mental/physical health. Used to connect spatial performance to human outcomes.

WHO heat-and-health evidence on rising heatwave exposure, vulnerable populations, shade/cooling, early warning and long-term maintenance of green/blue spaces. Used for thermal-comfort and heat-action gates.

IPCC AR6 WGII technical summary on heatwaves, extreme precipitation, urban heat islands, infrastructure interdependence and city-level adaptation. Used for stress-testing future scenarios, not for a site-specific forecast.

UN-Habitat people-centred smart-city playbook: participation, digital human rights, equity, sustainability, resilience, interoperability, budgeting and monitoring. Used to connect AI deployment with civic governance and post-occupancy review.

Beijing Meteorological Service catalogue for 1991-2020 district climate normals and city-scale ventilation, heat-island, microclimate and waterlogging services. The Haidian file is identified but not downloaded because the platform file API requires a user key; no unavailable values are quoted.

Beijing public-data record for the Haidian ground climate normals dataset: identifies station number, longitude, latitude and elevation fields and the municipal meteorological provider. Used to define a lawful input request and source metadata; no values are quoted because the API requires a registered user key.

Haidian government report describing the 1+21+65+100 meteorological monitoring network and access to wind direction/speed and flood-risk information. Used only as a coordination and data-availability context; it is not a Jing-Zhang site baseline or a permission to access restricted feeds.

Beijing station-authority report that a Qinghe station micro-weather station monitors temperature, pressure, humidity and wind direction/force. Used as nearby monitoring-context evidence only; it is not substituted for three-key-area observations or field calibration.

Haidian sponge-city planning context and a published 75%-80% annual runoff-control range. Used only as a screening range; the project target and drainage capacity require subcatchment, terrain, soil, pipe and outfall confirmation.

Beijing Master Plan context for a city ventilation-corridor network. Used to require local seasonal microclimate verification and unobstructed connections, not to claim that the provisional design axis is an official ventilation corridor.

Beijing embodied-intelligence action plan covering world-model simulation, multimodal data, pilot verification, open real-scene testing and human-robot trust. Used to define a staged test path, not to authorize public deployment or guarantee industrial targets.

Current national recommended standard GB/T 45502-2025 for service-robot information security. Used to require information-security review alongside physical safety; not a product certification or deployment approval.

National guidance on intelligent municipal infrastructure and resilient cities, including asset inventory, dynamic updates, lifecycle operation, simulation and warning for water, drainage, power, gas, heat and utility corridors. Used as an operations framework, not proof that local lifelines are digitally covered.

Current GB/T 33172-2016 asset-management overview, principles and terminology, equivalent to ISO 55000:2014. Used for asset ownership, lifecycle value, risk and continual-improvement logic; project service levels and budgets remain unknown.

Beijing guidance on bird-resource protection, habitat restoration, dark-sky protection and bird-friendly glass. Used to require ecological baselines and night-light controls, not to claim species presence on the site.

Beijing urban landscape-lighting guide with light-environment zoning and dark-sky protection. Used for low-glare, time-controlled and ecology-sensitive lighting directions; exact lighting classes require site classification and professional design.

2024 Beijing regional statistical yearbook, Chapter 2 district historical tables: Haidian population, GDP, fiscal revenue/expenditure, fixed-asset investment, retail, resident income, education and health for 2014-2023. Historical revisions and source departments are retained in the quantitative artifact.

Beijing Statistical Yearbook 2024 Chapter 7-8 tables: energy, water, wastewater, environmental quality/emissions, greening and public transit for 2014-2023. Table notes and initial-calculation warnings are preserved.
2024 Beijing statistical bulletin used only as city-level freshness context; it is not mixed into the Haidian 2014-2023 district model.
2025 Beijing statistical bulletin used only as city-level freshness context; it is not mixed into the Haidian 2014-2023 district model.

City of Helsinki public AI register: system overviews, detailed use information and a feedback route. Used as a transparency-and-feedback mechanism case, not as evidence of Haidian conditions or a model to copy wholesale.

City of Amsterdam algorithm register and Civic AI Lab context: explain what algorithms are used for and how they affect city services. Used as a public-accountability case; local procurement, legal and resident-review conditions remain unknown.

Singapore IMDA AI Verify and AI Verify Foundation: standardised testing, open-source collaboration and an assurance sandbox. Used as a test-before-public-use mechanism case, not as product certification or deployment approval.

Decidim Barcelona documentation: transparent and traceable participation, integration of face-to-face and digital participation, and open collaborative software. Used as a civic-commons case; participation outcomes cannot be transferred to this site without a local process.

UK Government Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard hub: a standardised way for public-sector bodies to publish why and how algorithmic tools are used. Used as a record-and-redress mechanism case, not as a local legal requirement.

Seoul Metropolitan Government public account of the Seoul AI Foundation: policy execution, public services, research, talent development and global collaboration. Used as an institutional-capacity case; it does not establish any partnership or implementation commitment for Jing-Zhang.

Street-canyon CFD case study used to define future checks for pedestrian airflow, air age and pollutant-removal conditions. It is method evidence only: it provides no Jing-Zhang geometry, boundary condition, measurement or performance result.

Case-specific monitoring and CFD study used to require joint review of prevailing wind, heat and PM2.5 trade-offs. Reported case percentages are not transferred to Jing-Zhang, and the paper is not evidence of local health outcomes.

Research on roof geometry, canyon aspect ratio and pollutant dynamics used only to identify parameters for later professional modelling. It does not prove that deeper canyons ventilate better on this site and supplies no local CFD or measured baseline.

AIJ pedestrian-wind CFD guideline used to require declared computational conditions and cross-comparison with field or benchmark evidence. It is a method boundary only, not a Jing-Zhang result or a transferred comfort threshold.

Architectural Institute of Japan guidebook page describing pedestrian-wind CFD validation benchmarks and the importance of geometry, inflow conditions and measurement points. Used as a public method route; the submission does not claim to have run an AIJ benchmark.

ISO catalogue record for the 2025 thermal-environment instrumentation standard. Used only to require professional review of instrument characteristics and measurement methods; the licensed standard text and any local thermal result are not included.
Processed navigation table for the three scope levels and their taskbook descriptors; not an official polygon or statutory planning control.
Processed navigation table for agent task requirements; the taskbook JSON and official announcement remain the governing evidence.
Processed source-use and boundary navigation table; it does not upgrade provisional or background material into formal evidence.
Processed checklist of official boundary, control, ownership, infrastructure and public-service gaps that must be confirmed before implementation.
